pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft piano intro, deep quiet atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
In this room where silence settles
your warmth still drifts in the air
words we once left for tomorrow
echo softly somewhere

Walking through forgotten moments
my heart pauses in between
like a fragile glass of memory
shaking in a quiet scene

[Chorus]
Your name returns again
though I try to let it fade
like a shadow on the water
it refuses to escape

No matter where I wander
or how far I try to go
something in the quiet dark
always leads me home

[Verse 2]
A voice that slowly disappeared
still lingers in my mind
moments I once tried to hold
remain like fragile lines

Even when I close my eyes
the picture becomes clear
a night that grows heavier
whenever you appear

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, deep reflective atmosphere)

[Bridge]
These unspoken feelings
scatter through the air
like quiet pieces of a heart
floating everywhere

Standing on the edge of memory
I whisper to the night
wondering if this wounded heart
will ever find the light

[Chorus]
Your shadow stays beside me
long after you are gone
and the question in my chest
keeps quietly moving on

If tomorrow comes again
without your voice or trace
will I learn to stand once more
in a different place

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, deep calm atmosphere)

At the far end of this night
a fragile thought appears

Someday
perhaps

I might love again
